$operator.summary: Pancreator self-development verification commands grouped by workflow purpose.
$operator.note: This template applies only when developing Pancreator itself. Embedded installations receive repository-checks.json instead.

configuration.description: Validate Pancreator governance, workflow, and projection configuration.

static.description: Run Pancreator formatting, type, and lint checks.

fast.description: Run Pancreator's compiled automated test suite.

impacted.description: Iteration profile, never a gate: select and run only the lane tests whose static import closure reaches the changed files. Run fast once at the end.

secondary.description: Run Pancreator's installer suites, which are outside the default lane.

full.description: Run complete documented verification: the aggregate lint/build/validate check, coverage thresholds, and the deterministic installer smoke harness. The coverage run executes every test lane once, so no lane runs twice.
